subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw doctor --fix automatically injects plugins.load.paths entry pointing at bundled plugin dir, causing circular warning

question: Should maintainers accept the linked repair strategy that stops bundled load-path writes and moves bundled-path cleanup after later doctor repair steps?
rationale: The issue is valid and already has an open fix PR, but the remaining decision is compatibility/proof acceptance for a persisted plugin-config update path.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85358 once maintainers are satisfied with current-head update and doctor idempotency proof.

options.title: Request a narrower revision
options.body: Ask the PR author to narrow or split the update/onboarding/doctor changes if maintainers only want one writer fixed first.

options.title: Reject this repair shape
options.body: Close the linked PR and keep this issue open only if maintainers want a different plugin-config migration policy.

recommendation.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85358 once maintainers are satisfied with current-head update and doctor idempotency proof.
